focus: Q3: create.sh recent-packets reliability and hardening (14-day window, created_at source, stderr in non-interactive runs, noise, no same-artifact matching; concrete defect candidates: invisible packets without derived.created_at, top-level-only scan, 10-row recency cap, no matching step).
answeredQuestions: Q3: How reliable and actionable is the create.sh recent-packets listing (14-day window, created_at source, stderr in non-interactive runs, noise, no same-artifact matching), and what concrete changes would harden it?

graphEvents.label: Q3 create.sh recent-packets reliability and hardening
Window, cap and zero-row paths fail silently
No matching step; topic never passed to lister
Stderr-only listing invisible to structured consumers
Three scenarios pinned; hardening paths uncovered
created_at is scaffold time; last_save_at unused

label: A packet whose graph-metadata.json carries derived.created_at is still dropped when description.json is missing: the graph-metadata read, the description.json read and the description assignment share one try block and the catch executes continue (create.sh:1098-1105), while normal-mode scaffolding tolerates a missing description.json with only a warning when dist/spec-folder/generate-description.js is absent (create.sh:1824-1838, warnings at 1834 and 1837); a packet without graph-metadata.json also falls into continue (create.sh:1099,1106). Census: 3 packet dirs carry derived.created_at without description.json (all under z_archive today), 173 of 4725 packet dirs carry no graph-metadata.json.

The scan is immediate-children-only: fs.readdirSync(specsDir) plus the /^[0-9]{3}-/ name test (create.sh:1093-1094) means phase children and nested sub-packets are invisible, and with --track the scan root narrows to that track (create.sh:980-982). Census over specs: 4725 NNN-named dirs, of which 4310 are nested under another packet (examples: specs/agents/009-turn-closeout-next-steps/001-deep-research through 006-deep-research synthesis), so the sibling set a series-parent decision is about is mostly outside the candidate set.

Filtering is silent: zero surviving rows exits before printing anything (create.sh:1112), the 14-day window excludes an older-but-relevant sibling without a trace (apply at create.sh:1091,1108), the 10-row cap truncates with no and-N-more marker (create.sh:1114), and missing dir or missing node also returns silently (create.sh:1082-1083). Tests pin the silence rather than a distinct no-candidates message (create-track-refresh.vitest.ts:180) and the phase-parent-append path prints nothing by design (create-track-refresh.vitest.ts:160-171), so an agent cannot distinguish no recent siblings from the lister never having run.

There is no matching step and the lister never receives the new work's topic: the node invocation passes only the scan root and the label (create.sh:1117) and the script reads only those two argv slots (create.sh:1089-1090), so FEATURE_DESCRIPTION and SHORT_NAME never reach it; rows carry only name, a 10-character date and a 100-character description (create.sh:1109,1114) and the closing nudge leaves the same-artifact comparison entirely to the reader (create.sh:1115). The trigger-index phrase scorer identified in f-iter001-005 is not wired in.

Stderr-only delivery is invisible to structured consumers: the stream split is deliberate to protect the --json stdout payload (create.sh:1076-1080, write at 1116; JSON parse asserted at create-track-refresh.vitest.ts:157), so there is no recent_packets field, a caller merging 2>&1 cannot parse stdout, and a caller that drops stderr loses the nudge entirely — speckit-plan.yaml:79 invokes create.sh in phase mode, where the listing is the only sibling surface.

Test coverage pins only three behaviors: happy-path header and row plus JSON stdout (create-track-refresh.vitest.ts:152-158), phase-parent-append silence (160-171) and 30-day exclusion (173-182). Uncovered: missing/blank description.json skip, missing derived.created_at, the 10-row cap and omission marker, nested-child and cross-track scanning, JSON-mode stderr behavior, and the zero-row output contract — every hardening candidate from this iteration needs new fixtures in this file.

The 14-day window uses derived.created_at only (create.sh:1091,1100,1108); last_save_at exists in the same metadata block and is never consulted (create.sh:617-618), so a packet created 30 days ago but saved yesterday is excluded, and metadata-less packets fall through the read catch into continue (create.sh:1098-1104).

list_recent_track_packets is advisory-only: a missing specs dir or missing node returns 0, the node call failure returns 0, and no failure may stop the scaffold (create.sh:1076-1084,1117); hardening must preserve this and must not move the pre-creation timing.

Census over specs (node walk, depth<=8): 4725 NNN-named dirs, 415 immediate children of non-packet dirs, 4310 nested under another packet; 4552 dirs carry graph-metadata.json with a derived.created_at string; 3 dirs carry derived.created_at but no description.json (all under z_archive); 173 dirs carry no graph-metadata.json.

direction: Use the 14-day create window as the same-artifact proximity heuristic
reason: The window measures scaffold age, not resemblance: it is keyed to derived.created_at (create.sh:1091,1100,1108), ignores last_save_at, and the census shows the sibling set is 91% nested and therefore outside the candidate set entirely; matching must be computed from the new work's topic, not inferred from recency.
